cases.name: scripted properties can be passed to luau
cases.expected_red_reason: The live ScriptedProperty listener owner invokes two listeners newest-first after the exact host rotation mutation, producing `changed with context` before `changed`; pinned C++ requires registration order.
cases.note: The owner test reads the pinned data_binding_test.riv schemas, applies the exact five host values, executes the literal typed Luau source, preserves direct and named rotation reads, host and script trigger actions, and asserts every ordered console line. Rust selects the same ViewModel schemas directly because this narrow scripting-owner test has no artboard-to-default-instance binding seam.

cases.name: Scripted blob property reads and writes bytes
cases.note: Pinned C++ constructs a standalone ViewModelInstanceAssetBlob; Rust's ScriptedPropertyBlob requires a real schema owner, supplied by the existing vendored blob fixture. The test then preserves the exact fixture-free RuntimeBlobAsset {10,20,30}, literal readSize/readByte/writeBytes script, fresh property wrappers per call, initial size 3 and byte 10 assertions, `abcd` write, retained asset length and bytes, final size 4, and byte `a`.
